title: fix: limit reported-issue quest to 30 days and 2 Pollen
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Limits retroactive issue rewards to the fixed 30-day pre-launch window.
- Pays 2 Quest Pollen per qualifying merged-PR issue.
- Explains each pending issue reward on the Quests page.
- Updates quest tests for the cutoff and reward amount.

gist.headline: A tidy little reward window
gist.blurb: The reported-issue Quest now knows exactly which past contributions belong in its garden: merged-PR issues from the 30-day pre-launch window, worth 2 Pollen each. Pending rewards also come with an explanation, because mysterious pollen is how folklore starts.
gist.summary: Fixed the reported-issue Quest so qualifying merged-PR issue rewards are limited to the 30-day pre-launch window, pay a fixed 2 Pollen each, and show an explanation for every pending reward on the Quests page.
gist.impact: Contributors can now clearly see which reported issues qualify, why a reward is pending, and that each qualifying merged-PR issue earns 2 Quest Pollen.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden keeper wearing a tiny accountant visor, checking a cozy pixel calendar with a clearly marked 30-day garden window and placing exactly two glowing Pollen seeds beside each qualifying issue-card plant. A friendly CRT monitor robot holds a Quest ledger explaining pending rewards, with flowers and code-vines growing around the desk.
